caption: The drawing is set on a rectangular piece of paper with a beige or light tan background. In the center is a bordered rectangular panel containing dense handwritten text in German, mostly in black ink with certain words and lines highlighted in red and some embellishments. The border of this central panel is decorated with a red and black wavy pattern. Above the panel is a cloud-shaped frame with more text inside, also in German and in red ink. On the left and right sides of the central panel are symmetrical decorative motifs: at the top, there is a stylized plant or flower motif featuring brown and red rounded shapes, green leaves, and yellow accent lines. Below these are two circular flower shapes on each side, each with six blue petals surrounding a yellow center, with red and yellow details. Under these, a striped horizontal bar in red and light brown sits atop a large stylized heart shape outlined in red, with green leaf-like forms inside the heart. At the bottom of the central panel, a row of nine circles, alternately filled with red, yellow, and green patterns, runs horizontally. The entire drawing is surrounded by a plain margin, and the name "ALBERT LEVONE" is printed in small type at the bottom right outside the main rectangle.
title: Birth Certificate (taufschein)
